purpose: Seed the next standard A-E vestibular for the Studium Labs ingestion pipeline.
notes: The 2026 first phase has 90 objective questions with one A-E answer per item.
The canonical answer key is published by VUNESP and was manually cross-checked against the mirror used for automated retrieval.

VUNESP returns HTTP 403 to the GitHub Actions downloader for the answer-key stream, so the package retrieves identical bytes/content from a public mirror while preserving the official URL as authority evidence.
The exam PDF is also a public mirror because the VUNESP Provas e Gabaritos area currently redirects to candidate login.
Mirror provenance must remain explicit; mirrored bytes are never relabeled as official.
This corpus entry is an ingestion input, not automatic catalog publication.
